author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 — proposes changing parse_request(body: Value, ...) to parse_request(body: &[u8], ...) so the kit can enforce the JSON-depth-cap internally rather than via documented caller responsibility. Mechanically: the kit would gain a serde_json::from_slice with a custom RecursionLimit, the caller-side recursion-limit obligation goes away.

Real value (the caller-responsibility list IS easy to miss), but the change forces a workspace-wide audit of every http transport layer to confirm they pass bytes rather than pre-parsed Value. Defer to major-bump.
